description_en: Queries the auto-renewal status of one or more subscription dedicated hosts
description_zh: 调用DescribeDedicatedHostAutoRenew查询一台或多台包年包月专有宿主机自动续费状态
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-dedicated-host-auto-renew --dedicated-host-ids dh-bp165p6xk2tlw61e0000,dh-bp1f9vxmno0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDedicatedHostAutoRenew

parameters.help_en: The IDs of dedicated hosts. You can specify up to 100 subscription dedicated host IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 专有宿主机ID。最多可以输入100个包年包月专有宿主机ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: dedicated_host_ids

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the dedicated host
parameters.help_zh: 专有宿主机所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

DedicatedHostRenewAttribute.description_en: The auto-renewal attributes of the dedicated hosts
DedicatedHostRenewAttribute.description_zh: 专有宿主机自动续费属性组成的数组

AutoRenewEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled. Valid values:
true: Auto-renewal is enabled.
false: Auto-renewal is disabled
AutoRenewEnabled.description_zh:
是否自动续费。可能值：
true：自动续费
false：不自动续费

AutoRenewWithEcs.description_en:
Indicates whether the dedicated host is automatically renewed along with subscription ECS instances hosted on it. When auto-renewal is performed for a subscription ECS instance and the renewal causes the ECS instance expiration date to be later than the dedicated host expiration date, the dedicated host can be automatically renewed along with the ECS instance. Valid values:

AutoRenewWithEcs: The dedicated host follows the ECS instance for auto-renewal.
StopRenewWithEcs: The dedicated host does not follow the ECS instance for auto-renewal
AutoRenewWithEcs.description_zh:
包年包月专有宿主机内的包年包月ECS实例自动续费时，如果ECS实例续费后的到期时间比专有宿主机的到期时间晚，则该专有宿主机是否随ECS实例自动续费。可能值：

AutoRenewWithEcs：跟随ECS实例自动续费。
StopRenewWithEcs：不跟随ECS实例自动续费

DedicatedHostId.description_en: The ID of the dedicated host

PeriodUnit.description_en:
The unit of the renewal period. Valid values:

Week
Month
PeriodUnit.description_zh:
续费单位。可能值：

Week
Month

RenewalStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled for the subscription dedicated host. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: Auto-renewal is enabled.
Normal: Auto-renewal is disabled but the dedicated host is not set to non-renewal.
NotRenewal: Auto-renewal is disabled and no expiration notification is sent. Alibaba Cloud sends a non-renewal notification three days before the dedicated host expires. You can change the value to Normal for the dedicated host and then manually renew it by calling [RenewDedicatedHosts]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93287.html）, or set it to AutoRenewal
RenewalStatus.description_zh:
是否自动续费包年包月专有宿主机。取值范围：

AutoRenewal：自动续费。
Normal：待续费。
NotRenewal：不续费，也不发送到期提醒。到期前第三天阿里云会发送不续费提醒。不续费的专有宿主机可以设置成待续费（Normal），再自行续费[RenewDedicatedHosts]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93287.html）或设置为自动续费（AutoRenewal）
